ideas.name: BOJ ETF Purchase Afternoon Effect
ideas.claim: A study cited by the Bank of Japan reports higher afternoon returns for Nikkei 225-linked ETFs on BOJ ETF purchase days than on other days.
ideas.quote: An early study by Ide and Minami (2013) focuses on the returns of ETFs linked to the Nikkei Stock Average (Nikkei 225) during the afternoon session, reporting that their returns during the afternoon session tend to be higher on days when the Bank of Japan purchased ETFs than they are on other days.
ideas.mechanism: EVENT: BOJ ETF purchases and afternoon returns

rules.filters: BOJ ETF purchase day; purchase trigger not stated

not_stated: availability of the purchase signal during the session
ideas.claimed_result: Afternoon returns tend to be higher on BOJ ETF purchase days than on other days; effect size not stated.
required_data: BOJ ETF purchase dates and signal availability
